panels.title: HOW THE BOT THINKS — Signal Breakdown
Edge Score (Live)
panels.description: This is the single most important number. It combines every factor below into one confidence score (0-100). >70 = the bot has a statistical edge worth acting on. The Brain only trades when this gauge is green.

panels.title: Signal Recipe (Why Edge is High/Low)
panels.description: This table shows the exact ingredients that created the current Edge Score. Example row: Trend=StrongUp (weight 35%), VolumeSpike=Yes (weight 25%), RSI=Neutral (weight 15%). New traders: the bot is NOT guessing — it is adding up weighted evidence like a detective.

panels.title: Trend Compass History
panels.description: Shows how strongly the market has been trending over the last 6h. Green area = uptrend the bot likes for LONGs. Red = downtrend it likes for SHORTs. Flat line = choppy market where the bot stays in cash.

title: Volatility (ATR) — Market Weather History
description: How wild the price swings are. High spikes = Storm. The Brain automatically reduces position size or stops trading when this line shoots up. Beginners lose money in storms — the bot protects you here.

title: Order Book Imbalance
description: Are buyers or sellers heavier right now on the order book? +70 = strong buying pressure (favors LONG). This is one of the 'micro' signals the bot uses to confirm macro trend.

title: Funding Rate Pressure
description: On perpetual futures: positive = longs are paying shorts (crowded long side). The Brain avoids piling into crowded trades. Think of this as 'how expensive is it to stay in this position?'
